title: Dashboard can't read the nightly report files -- the job that makes them runs fine
description_md:
A nightly cron job, run as the unprivileged `reportgen` account, drops report files into `/var/lib/reports/` for a separate dashboard process (running as the unprivileged `dashboard` account, a member of the `reportreaders` group meant to have read access there) to pick up and display. The job itself completes successfully every time -- but the dashboard has started showing 'permission denied' reading the very files the job just created. SSH in as `trainee` (passwordless `sudo`), find the report-generation script, work out what's silently changing the mode of the files it writes, and fix it so the dashboard can read them again.

You're done when a freshly generated report file can be read by the `dashboard` user.
